texts.facts: This is petition filed by the petitioner u/sec. 12 of Protection Of Women From Domestic Violence Act, 2005. Further, the respondent is not earning a sum of Rs.10,00,000/- per month as alleged in the petition. Further, respondent no.1 is not working at present and earlier the respondent no.1 was working as attender in real estate office, the said office has been closed after demonetization. 14. It is a love marriage and marriage was performed at the temple at cost of the respondent no.1 as they are from different caste. As such giving or taking dowry does not arise. Wherein, in petitioner had started harassing the respondent no.1 and the petitioner had stopped cooking and doing household work for which, the respondent no.1 asked the mother and sister of the petitioner to quit their residence. The respondent no.1 has not tortured physically or mentally to the petitioner at any point of time as alleged in the petition.
texts.arguments: Thereafter, also the 17 C.Misc. 130/2017 respondent had looked after the petitioner with fulfilling her all necessities with love and affection.
